            python {ROOT}/scripts/drop_excluded_tracts.py {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/ape/s1/${contig}_M1.bed {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/ape/s1/excluded/${contig}_homopolymers.bed $WORK/timed_out.bed {ROOT}/output/precompute/ape/s1/unresolved_haplotypes/${contig}.bed > {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/ape/s1/M1/tracts/${contig}.bed.tmp

        awk -F'\t' -v OFS='\t' '$4 == "timed_out" {print $1, $2, $3}' {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/excluded/chunks/c2_long_periods_0.bed \
            > $WORK/timed_out.bed
        for contig in c2; do
            python {ROOT}/scripts/drop_excluded_tracts.py {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/${contig}_M0.bed {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/excluded/${contig}_homopolymers.bed $WORK/timed_out.bed {ROOT}/output/precompute/monkey/s3/unresolved_haplotypes/${contig}.bed > {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M0/tracts/${contig}.bed.tmp
            mv {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M0/tracts/${contig}.bed.tmp {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M0/tracts/${contig}.bed
            python {ROOT}/scripts/drop_excluded_tracts.py {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/${contig}_M1.bed {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/excluded/${contig}_homopolymers.bed $WORK/timed_out.bed {ROOT}/output/precompute/monkey/s3/unresolved_haplotypes/${contig}.bed > {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M1/tracts/${contig}.bed.tmp
            mv {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M1/tracts/${contig}.bed.tmp {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M1/tracts/${contig}.bed
            python {ROOT}/scripts/drop_excluded_tracts.py {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/${contig}_M2.bed {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/excluded/${contig}_homopolymers.bed $WORK/timed_out.bed {ROOT}/output/precompute/monkey/s3/unresolved_haplotypes/${contig}.bed > {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M2/tracts/${contig}.bed.tmp
            mv {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M2/tracts/${contig}.bed.tmp {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M2/tracts/${contig}.bed
        done
        # The tracts and their bases in repeat BEDs, tab-separated.
        count() { awk 'FNR > 1 {n++; bp += $3 - $2} END {print n + 0 "\t" bp + 0}' "$@"; }
        printf "model\ttracts\tbp\ttracts_measured\tbp_measured\tspecies\tsample\n" > {ROOT}/results/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/tracts_summary.tsv.tmp
        printf "M0\t%s\t%s\tmonkey\ts3\n" "$(count {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/c2_M0.bed)" "$(count {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M0/tracts/c2.bed)" >> {ROOT}/results/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/tracts_summary.tsv.tmp
        printf "M1\t%s\t%s\tmonkey\ts3\n" "$(count {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/c2_M1.bed)" "$(count {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M1/tracts/c2.bed)" >> {ROOT}/results/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/tracts_summary.tsv.tmp
        printf "M2\t%s\t%s\tmonkey\ts3\n" "$(count {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/c2_M2.bed)" "$(count {ROOT}/output/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/M2/tracts/c2.bed)" >> {ROOT}/results/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/tracts_summary.tsv.tmp
        mv {ROOT}/results/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/tracts_summary.tsv.tmp {ROOT}/results/repetitive_indels/monkey/s3/tracts_summary.tsv
